title: Week 11 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “civil liberty”?
options: Compelled testimonial evidence exposing a person to criminal liability.
A tax applying the same rate across the tax base.
A protected freedom limiting government interference.
Comparison of the additional benefit and additional cost of one more unit or action.
questions.explanation: Civil liberty means a protected freedom limiting government interference.
choices: Compelled testimonial evidence exposing a person to criminal liability.
A tax applying the same rate across the tax base.
A protected freedom limiting government interference.
Comparison of the additional benefit and additional cost of one more unit or action.

A judicial opinion disagreeing with the majority’s result or reasoning.
A measure of how responsive one variable is to a change in another.
Application of Bill of Rights protections to states through the Fourteenth Amendment.
questions.explanation: Incorporation means application of Bill of Rights protections to states through the Fourteenth Amendment.

A rule that government generally may regulate expression without favoring or suppressing a viewpoint.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “prior restraint”?
options: A legal, technological, financial, strategic, or structural obstacle to new competition.
Government action preventing publication or expression before it occurs.
A supporter of ratifying the Constitution and strengthening national government.
The ability to access, analyze, evaluate, create, and verify messages across media forms.
questions.explanation: Prior restraint means government action preventing publication or expression before it occurs.
choices: A legal, technological, financial, strategic, or structural obstacle to new competition.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “establishment clause”?
options: A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.
The First Amendment prohibition on government establishment of religion.
The process by which issues gain or lose public and governmental attention.
A public guarantee protecting eligible deposits up to legal limits.
questions.explanation: Establishment clause means the First Amendment prohibition on government establishment of religion.
choices: A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.
The First Amendment prohibition on government establishment of religion.
The process by which issues gain or lose public and governmental attention.
A public guarantee protecting eligible deposits up to legal limits.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “free exercise clause”?
options: A good that is difficult to exclude people from and can be used without substantially reducing availability to others.
Rapid withdrawals driven by fear that an institution cannot meet obligations.
A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.
The First Amendment protection for religious belief and practice, subject to legal doctrine.
questions.explanation: Free exercise clause means the First Amendment protection for religious belief and practice, subject to legal doctrine.
